monsters.name: Gull swarm
monsters.text: Forty white gulls with one mind and no manners, diving for your eyes.

monsters.name: Brine crawler
monsters.text: A crab the size of a handcart, its shell crusted with barnacles and its claws like garden shears.

monsters.name: Deserter
monsters.text: A soldier in a stolen coat who has not slept properly in a month and has run out of other ideas.

monsters.name: Syndicate thug
monsters.text: A broad-shouldered dock-hand with a cudgel and a very polite voice, which makes it worse.

monsters.name: Syndicate enforcer
monsters.text: A lean woman in a grey coat with a tidy knife in each hand. She apologises before she cuts you.

monsters.name: Drowned sailor
monsters.text: A bloated sailor wrapped in briar and kelp, who walked out of the sea with water running from his mouth.

monsters.name: Osk Dray
monsters.text: A paunchy, soft-voiced fence in a velvet waistcoat, who turns out to be quite a lot quicker than he looks.

on_defeat.message: Osk slides down the strongroom wall, wheezing. The salt shard rolls out of his waistcoat and across the floor to your boot.
